evidence.title: GitHub - Mathieu2301/TradingView-API: 📈 Get real-time stocks from TradingView · GitHub

name: TradingView-API
summary: Community JavaScript/TypeScript client that fetches TradingView market data: candles, quotes, indicators and screeners.
description: Independent library (not an official TradingView API) for market data: candles and quotes over websockets, indicator values, strategy reports, symbol metadata, screeners, hotlists and read-only account watchlists. V4 is a TypeScript, ESM rewrite (Node >= 20 or Bun) with a high-level data API (getCandles, watchQuotes, getScreener …) and a low-level client for charts, replay and studies; docs come in English, French, Spanish and Portuguese.
contains: data API: getCandles, watchCandles, getQuote(s), watchQuotes, getIndicatorData, getScreener, getHotlist, getWatchlists
low-level client: charts, replay, studies, accounts
interactive setup launcher via npx, with Claude Code/Codex prompts
